decisions.reason: As a platform close to the firm’s core enterprise geospatial business, its continued visibility after launch suggests performance at least near aspiration levels and its strategic fit justifies retaining it.

Mobile field data capture fits established customer needs and remained prominently marketed, so with industry growth and some organizational slack management would likely keep it unless results clearly fell short.

The product showed post-launch versioning and is close to the existing web-map offer, but as a narrower extension it is more exposed to problemistic search and portfolio pruning if returns disappoint.
